$comment: The task contract the Boss fills for every dispatch. dispatch-worker builds the worker's brief from these fields plus the prompt file; it deliberately does NOT paste the Boss's conversation or the repository. Keep each value the smallest thing the worker needs to act correctly — the brief in the prompt file carries the specifics.
objective: Measure the static composition height of the assembly band at 360 and 1280 and report whether its sticky shell pins.
acceptance_criteria: report the band section's rendered height in px at 360 and at 1280
report whether .assembly-band__shell top holds at 0 across the pin window
report the measured boxes of the immovable bar, MobileDock and Header in px
expected_output: the fenced JSON block defined in dispatch-worker's prompt template

$notes.why_task_id_is_not_a_beads_id: task_id names the artifact (.agent-pair/inbox/<worker>/<task-id>.json) and the lock; beads_id is the execution issue if one exists. They are separate because Spec Kit tasks.md stays the planned source and Beads is live state.
$notes.why_verification_commands_is_a_string_li: dispatch-worker runs each one after the worker exits and records its real exit code. A worker that exits 0 but fails verification is reported 'failed', never 'completed'.
